While a retry sequence is open (_retry_attempt > 0), a callback failure with no retry reason, or a callback answer with neither key nor headers, ends the attempt as a non-retryable error message. A second guard (_close_retry_sequence_on_raise) closes the sequence on any raise out of the backoff or the re-run (a hook, an adapter, a cancelled prompt). A refusal on the first attempt is unchanged: AgentHarnessError, rc 1. 2. Logout while a retry waits: kept as it is. The transient statuses are now exactly pi's set: 429, 500, 502, 503, 504, 520, 524, plus the transport errors. 501, 505 and other statuses fail at once. 4. The setup error is now emitted as a start event then an error event, so message_start comes before message_end. 5. A transient failure now uses pi's text 'OAuth refresh failed for

findings.title: Cat1: message_end hook that round-trips error_message through JSON changes retry classification
findings.detail: A message_end hook that sets error_message to json.loads(json.dumps(error_message)) leaves the text the same but turns _SetupErrorText into a plain str. The classifier at harness/core.py:2386 then reads the text. A 401 invalid_grant refusal whose body contains '502' is retried and ends with success true. A RemoteProtocolError disconnect gets no retry at all. Without the hook: refusal ends (False,1) and the disconnect retries to success.

blocking.title: The guide's logout claim is false for the window a retry actually waits in
blocking.detail:
docs/guides/providers-and-models.md:298-299 (and its bundled copy) says: 'If another aelix logs you out while a retry waits, the retry uses what a new turn would: the next key in the order above.' models-json.md:351-353 says the retry 'resolves this list again'. I emptied auth.json during the 2 s backoff in live rpc runs (anthropic and codex). The retry sent nothing and did not fall to the next key. It ended the sequence with auto_retry_end(False,1) and the text 'The auth.json entry for

is an OAuth login that gave no key ... remove the

entry from /auth.json'. Cause: the in-memory entry is still the expired OAuth one, and get_oauth_api_key re-reads under the lock, finds nothing and returns None (auth_storage.py:489-490).
blocking.evidence: Only a logout inside the refresh request reaches the env key. That is the lane's row test_a_logout_while_a_retry_waits_sends_what_a_new_turn_would: its logout runs inside the token handler, not during the wait. A new turn in the same session after a logout fails the same way (logs/v_rpc_logout_then_new_turn_expired.out), so the CHANGELOG's 'uses what a new turn would' holds; the guides' 'next key in the order above' does not. Fix: docs only, plus a row for the logout during the backoff. The behaviour is safe (nothing is sent). Logs: logs/v_rpc_logout_during_backoff.out and logs/v_rpc_logout_during_backoff_codex.out (kit .omc/probes/379-live/r2verify/).
